description: This file contains utility functions for challenges in the FreeCodeCamp project, including URL generation, status checking, link transformation, accessibility enhancements for code blocks, collapsible code sections, and scrollbar styling.

methods.name: getGuideUrl
methods.description: Generates a URL to a forum topic or search page based on provided forum topic ID and title.

methods.name: isGoodXHRStatus
methods.description: Checks if an HTTP status code indicates a successful or acceptable response.

methods.name: transformEditorLink
methods.description: Transforms URLs from repl.it and glitch.me to their respective editor URLs.

methods.name: enhancePrismAccessibility
methods.description: Adds accessibility attributes to PrismJS code blocks for better screen reader support.

methods.name: makePrismCollapsible
methods.description: Wraps PrismJS code blocks in collapsible sections for better UI.

methods.name: setScrollbarArrowStyles
methods.description: Adjusts CSS variables to style scrollbar arrows based on scrollbar width.
